messages:
Priya (People Ops): FYI new hire Aisha Khan (remote-CA) - BG returned with SSN last4 mismatch. Candidate says she lost her physical SSN card. Vendor is asking for alternate docs.
Sam (Recruiter): Aisha said she can provide a W-2 or IRS tax transcript. She can also get a notary to verify other IDs.
bg-check-bot: Background check status: REVIEW_REQUIRED - SSN_MISMATCH. Report: https://bg.example.com/reports/AK-99012
Gabe (Hiring Manager): Can we still ship laptop and do remote orientation on Day 1 if we don't have SSN verification yet? Start date is Mon 11/17.
Priya (People Ops): We usually require identity verification before issuing payroll/benefits access, but can provision a loaner laptop and limited SSO if Security signs off on provisional access. Need an adjudication note from vendor saying candidate provided acceptable alternate docs.
Anika (Security): For provisional access: no production credentials, no AWS, no keyrings. IT can get a restricted group. Also need audit trail of docs submitted.
Sam (Recruiter): I've asked Aisha to upload a scanned W-2 and the IRS transcript PDF to the secure intake portal. I also offered the remote I-9 authorized agent option if she prefers.
Priya (People Ops): Remote I-9 option: candidate hires an authorized agent/notary who completes Section 3 and attaches agent ID. Candidate also needs to sign electronically Section 1. We then upload scanned I-9 to Workday. Template for agent note in handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/hr/remote-i9-agent-template
Gabe (Hiring Manager): If vendor takes >72h to adjudicate, do we postpone benefits enrollment window? The benefits open on day 1 for new hires.
Priya (People Ops): Benefits enrollment will be held until SSN verification completes. We enroll them manually once cleared. Communicated to payroll already.
IT-provision-bot: Provision request queued: loaner-laptop + restricted-sso for Aisha Khan. Ticket ID: PROV-1427. ETA: 1 business day.
Gabe (Hiring Manager): Ok. Please ensure onboarding checklist still includes payroll docs step. I want Aisha to join orientation even if benefits are delayed.
Priya (People Ops): Agreed. We'll run the standard Day 1 orientation (culture, security basics, manager intro) remotely. No access to production. Sam, please confirm Aisha's timezone for scheduling.
Sam (Recruiter): Aisha is in Pacific (PST). Prefers 10am start. She just uploaded a W-2 and emailed a brief note about SSN card lost. Vendor confirmed receipt at 15:02.
bg-check-bot: Background check status updated: AWAITING_VENDOR_ADJUDICATION (2025-11-14 15:02)
Anika (Security): Once vendor adjudicates, please DM me the outcome. If they accept W-2 + transcript, we'll clear provisional access to dev-staging only. If not, we'll pause provisioning.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. I'll also add a benefits hold flag to payroll record so enrollment link is suppressed until cleared.
Gabe (Hiring Manager): Thanks. Small ask: can we ship the laptop overnight to her so she can join Day 1 hands-on with local envs (staging only)?
IT-provision-bot: Shipping expedited available after manual approval by People Ops. Priya, approve PROV-1427-expedite?
Priya (People Ops): Approving expedited shipping for loaner laptop (PROV-1427-expedite) so Aisha can join Day 1. Reminder: sign NDA in onboarding doc and upload ID scans to secure portal.
Sam (Recruiter): I'll send Aisha the checklist + notary wording and confirm pickup/shipping address.
Priya (People Ops): Filing thread notes for audit. We will update when vendor adjudicates. :white_check_mark:
bg-check-bot: Background check status updated: ADJUDICATED_CLEARABLE (2025-11-15 09:47) - vendor accepted alternative docs.
Anika (Security): Received adjudication note. Clearing provisional access to dev-staging groups. IT, please add Aisha to restricted-sso group.
IT-provision-bot: Done. Aisha added to restricted-sso, laptop shipped (tracking: TRK-554433).
Gabe (Hiring Manager): Great. Priya, confirm benefits enrollment will be opened now?
Priya (People Ops): Benefits hold released, enrollment link sent to Aisha. Payroll notified to finalize payroll setup. All set.
Sam (Recruiter): Welcome aboard Aisha! :tada:
